title: Cash Back Moto
description: A bilingual (English and Arabic, right-to-left) catalog website for a motorcycle and scooter dealer with branches in Alexandria and Cairo. Built with Next.js 16, TypeScript and Tailwind CSS, and deployed on Vercel.

title: 7GZ-KORA
description: An installable app (PWA) for weekly football nights: sign-ups with a waiting list, live game tracking, cost splitting and peer voting. Player ratings are computed by a PostgreSQL function, covered by 238 tests.

title: Cloud Load Balancer Simulator
description: A multithreaded Java simulation of a cloud load balancer: one thread per server with a blocking task queue and round-robin dispatch, plus a web dashboard that compares round robin, least connections and random.

title: EVE Robot
description: A teleoperated, self-balancing robot built with ROS 2 and a Raspberry Pi 4. A PlayStation controller drives it through a browser control panel, and two ultrasonic sensors measure distance.

title: SIC/XE Assembler
description: A two-pass assembler for the SIC/XE architecture, written in Python. The first pass builds the symbol table and location counter, and the second generates object code.

title: Bean Plant Classification
description: A LightGBM classifier for bean plant varieties, trained on a Kaggle dataset in Google Colab and reaching 93.15% accuracy.
